source_text: Updated in 2020, the guidelines—"Preventing HIV through safe voluntary medical male circumcision for adolescents and adults"—incorporate evidence on surgical techniques, including device-based methods for faster procedures, adolescent-specific counseling to ensure informed consent, and integration with sexual health services, while modeling estimates that sustained VMMC scale-up could avert up to 3.3 million HIV infections in eastern and southern Africa by 2025. [56]
